Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after approval and credited to the original payment method.
You can track your order under My Orders > Track Package. Tracking updates every 6-8 hours.
Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days. If it has been longer, we auto-escalate to check with the courier.
Items can be returned within 15 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.
Orders can be cancelled from My Orders within 1 hour of placing them, before they are packed for shipping.
Please upload a photo of the damaged item within 48 hours of delivery; a replacement is auto-approved on verification.
If payment failed but amount was deducted, it auto-reverses within 3-5 business days. Try an alternate payment method.
Delivery address can only be changed before the order is shipped; contact support immediately if it has already shipped.
Loyalty points are credited within 24 hours of delivery confirmation and can be redeemed on your next order.
